keywords: ACDT #66 敲定 Glamsterdam CFI 范围含 EIP-8037
bal-devnet-2 加入四个非头号 EIP
zkEVM 时代 gas 应反映证明成本
EIP-7778 新增 gas_spent 收据字段
summary: ACDT #66：bal-devnet-2 目标 1 月底，加入 SLOTNUM、SWAPN 等操作码、ETH 转账日志与无退款区块 gas 计算；Glamsterdam CFI 范围敲定，EIP-8037 状态创建 gas 上调在内，需要应用开发者对动态成本提供反馈。ladislaus0x 解释 zkEVM 时代如何让 gas 反映证明成本以防 DoS。

items.title: ACDT #66
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #8：bal-devnet-2 目标 1 月底，加入 EIP-7843 SLOTNUM、EIP-8024 SWAPN/DUPN/EXCHANGE、EIP-7708 ETH 转账日志与 EIP-7778 无退款区块 gas 计算；CFI 范围敲定，包括 EIP-8037 状态创建 gas 上调，Marius van der Wijden 的 解读 指出它让 gas limit 提高时无需每次重新定价状态操作，应用开发者需对动态成本提供反馈。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #8: bal-devnet-2 targets late January with EIP-7843 SLOTNUM, EIP-8024 SWAPN, DUPN and EXCHANGE, EIP-7708 ETH transfer logs and EIP-7778 refund free block gas accounting; CFI scope is final, including the EIP-8037 state creation gas increase, and Marius van der Wijden's explainer notes it allows gas limit increases without repricing state operations each time, with app developer feedback needed on the dynamic cost.

keywords_en: ACDT #66 finalizes Glamsterdam CFI scope including EIP-8037
bal-devnet-2 adds four non headliner EIPs
gas should reflect proving cost in the zkEVM era
EIP-7778 adds a gas_spent receipt field
summary_en: ACDT #66: bal-devnet-2 targets late January and adds the SLOTNUM and SWAPN family opcodes, ETH transfer logs and refund free block gas accounting; Glamsterdam CFI scope was finalized, including the EIP-8037 state creation gas increase, with app developer feedback needed on dynamic costs. ladislaus0x explained how gas will reflect proving cost in the zkEVM era to prevent DoS.
